label: CSS326-24G-2S+RM
description: MikroTik CSS326-24G-2S+RM - SwOS-only switch: 24x 1G RJ45 and 2x 10G SFP+ cages, fanless 1U rackmount.
notes: MikroTik spec table, row Ethernet '10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 24' and row Fiber 'SFP+ ports: 2'; the product text adds "SFP cage supports both 1.25 Gb SFP and 10 Gb SFP+ modules", so the two cages carry speedCaps 1000/10000. Copper ports are 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets, which is what the template now declares. Passive PoE-in on the DC jack, not PoE-out on any port. Source: https://mikrotik.com/product/CSS326-24G-2SplusRM
